obligations.objective: Make context an explicit input to Aspect role interpretation and MTO evaluation.
obligations.acceptance_test: Same primitive organization under two contexts yields separately typed results or an explicit context conflict.
obligations.escalation: Block equivalence and MTO claims until context is supplied.

obligations.objective: Establish single-valued MTO selection or an explicit unresolved-result path.
obligations.acceptance_test: Repeated evaluation of the same declared candidate input returns one candidate RT or the same unresolved diagnostic.
obligations.escalation: Block deterministic execution and require a canonical selector.

obligations.objective: Preserve primitive multiplicity through OTM or prove that multiplicity is irrelevant.
obligations.acceptance_test: Inputs with repeated primitives remain distinguishable after decomposition whenever later MTO can observe multiplicity.
obligations.escalation: Reject set-only decomposition for affected domains.

obligations.objective: Define unique canonical orientation tie keys and deterministic tie-breaking.
obligations.acceptance_test: Permuting candidate discovery order produces the same selected orientation; duplicate keys are rejected.
obligations.escalation: Return unresolved orientation and block MTO closure.

obligations.objective: Prevent inference of aspect equivalence from matching observed outputs alone.
obligations.acceptance_test: Distinct organizations with equal observed output remain equivalence-unestablished absent a declared MTO/RT identity rule.
obligations.escalation: Reject substitution/equivalence inference and retain both source organizations.
